description: This file defines the ACLRolesViewList class, which extends ViewList, and includes a preDisplay method that checks user permissions and configures a ListViewSmarty instance for displaying ACL roles.

classes.name: ACLRolesViewList
classes.description: A view class responsible for listing ACL roles with custom pre-display behavior including access control and list view setup.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Checks if the current user has admin or developer access to Users module; if not, terminates execution. Otherwise, initializes and configures a ListViewSmarty object for display.
